CREATE BROKER PRIORITY bp FOR CONVERSATION SET(CONTRACT_NAME=ANY,LOCAL_SERVICE_NAME=ANY,REMOTE_SERVICE_NAME=ANY,PRIORITY_LEVEL=10);
ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET CHANGE_TRACKING=ON(CHANGE_RETENTION=2 DAYS,AUTO_CLEANUP=ON); CREATE TABLE dbo.t(i int PRIMARY KEY); ALTER TABLE dbo.t ENABLE CHANGE_TRACKING WITH(TRACK_COLUMNS_UPDATED=ON);

CREATE MESSAGE TYPE message VALIDATION=NONE; CREATE CONTRACT contract(message SENT BY ANY); CREATE QUEUE dbo.queue; CREATE SERVICE service ON QUEUE dbo.queue(contract); DECLARE @h uniqueidentifier; BEGIN DIALOG CONVERSATION @h FROM SERVICE service TO SERVICE N'service' ON CONTRACT contract WITH ENCRYPTION=OFF; SEND ON CONVERSATION @h MESSAGE TYPE message(N'hello'); CREATE BROKER PRIORITY bound_priority FOR CONVERSATION SET(CONTRACT_NAME=contract,LOCAL_SERVICE_NAME=service,REMOTE_SERVICE_NAME=ANY,PRIORITY_LEVEL=10);

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ds WITH(LOCATION='abs://container@example.invalid'); CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT fmt WITH(FORMAT_TYPE=DELIMITEDTEXT); EXEC(N'CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.t(i int) WITH(LOCATION=''probe.csv'',DATA_SOURCE=ds,FILE_FORMAT=fmt);');

CREATE TABLE dbo.t(i int); EXEC(N'CREATE FUNCTION dbo.predicate(@i int) RETURNS TABLE WITH SCHEMABINDING AS RETURN SELECT 1 AS allowed WHERE @i=1;'); EXEC(N'CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.policy ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.predicate(i) ON dbo.t WITH(STATE=ON);');

ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE(QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE=ALL); CREATE TABLE dbo.q(i int); INSERT dbo.q VALUES(1),(2); EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'SELECT SUM(i)+@i AS pbps2236_query_intent FROM dbo.q OPTION(MAXDOP 1);',N'@i int',@i=42; EXEC sys.sp_query_store_flush_db; DECLARE @q bigint,@p bigint; SELECT TOP(1) @q=q.query_id,@p=p.plan_id FROM sys.query_store_query q JOIN sys.query_store_query_text t ON q.query_text_id=t.query_text_id JOIN sys.query_store_plan p ON p.query_id=q.query_id WHERE t.query_sql_text LIKE N'(@i int)SELECT SUM(i)+@i%'; IF @q IS NULL THROW 50000,'the owned query was not captured',1; EXEC sys.sp_query_store_set_hints @query_id=@q,@query_hints=N'OPTION(MAXDOP 2)'; ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE(QUERY_CAPTURE_MODE=AUTO);
